config.grain_rationale: One record = one current Australian credit licence (CRED_LIC_NUM) held by a business licensee; the business's attributes (name, ABN/ACN, address) are those of the licensee.

record_id.rationale: CRED_LIC_NUM is present on 100% of records and distinct on 100% of the discovery partition (464/464) - one row per licence.

fields.rationale: ASIC licensee register name; predominantly registered company names (PTY LTD / LIMITED), but some rows carry individual licensee names like 'TAN, JINTANG' (sole traders) - the column is the licensee's registered name either way.
CRED_LIC_BN is the business name of the licensee (present on 34.5% of rows, distinct, not a legal-name form). Business name -> trading_name.

ABN_ACN field holds an 11-digit ABN for 420/464 rows; profile shows abn checksum-valid rate 0.905 over all rows. Regex restricts to exactly the 11-digit shape so 9-digit ACNs and the '0' placeholder do not land here.
27 rows in the discovery partition carry a 9-digit value in ABN_ACN - the ACN shape. Validated with the acn checksum transform; non-conforming values yield no observation rather than a guessed ACN.
Dataset is 'Current' licensees; every discovery row is APPR. Unlisted codes fall back to unknown.
Locality/suburb of the licensee's registered address.
All values are already AU state abbreviations (NSW/VIC/QLD/WA/SA/ACT/TAS/NT).
All values match dd/mm/yyyy (day-first, ASIC convention); this is when the licence took effect.
Empty for all current licences; same dd/mm/yyyy format. Null means still current.

constants.rationale: Australian credit licensing regime administered by ASIC; all states are AU and licensing is domestic. No country column present.

unmapped.reason: Constant 'Credit Licence' for all rows - describes the register, adds no entity attribute.
The licence's own identifier, not a business identifier. Used only as record_id.
Australian Financial Services licence number - a related-licence identifier, not an entity field; equals the credit licence number where present and '0' for 425/464 rows.
Free-text status/condition history present on 0.2% of rows; no ontology target and too sparse/irregular to parse.
External dispute resolution scheme memberships (AFCA/COSL/FOS, '~'-separated) - no ontology target.
Latitude of the locality, not of a street address; address.full is not available and no geo target exists in the ontology.
Longitude of the locality; no geo target exists in the ontology.
Free-text licence authorisations/conditions - licence scope, not an entity attribute.

config.notes: Grain is licence-level but each licence maps 1:1 to a licensee business. CRED_LIC_NAME is the licensee's registered name: mostly companies, occasionally individuals (sole traders) - mapped to legal_name with moderate confidence since the register itself uses this as the legal licensee name; no separate trading-name column ambiguity. ABN_ACN mixes ABN (11d), ACN (9d), and the placeholder '0'; each is routed by digit-length regex to the checksummed transform. entity_type left unmapped (names suggest companies but the source does not state a type field).
